followup_reviews.Research finding: The late-July 2019 freight strike remains supported and included; UNB describes the same named-post episode rather than a new parent. Both goods directions were stopped while travellers and internal port work remained normal. Allegations of harassment are attributed to associations and drivers, not certified misconduct. Propose 30 July exact onset/status using UNB’s actual Tuesday-morning report, with the 2019 event-year match explicitly inferred from the dated contemporary episode. Keep unknown reopening, no later continuity, numeric durations withheld and zero complete flags. Retain Trade and protectionism / Trade and transport protests for the attributed commercial grievances; no state protectionist intention is inferred. Daily Star and UNB were freshly read; SAWTEE is the same Daily Star origin. The UNB body lacks a year and partly shares named local actors, so neither metadata certainty nor fully independent witnesses are exaggerated. The phase remains unlocated with evidence-only display; the start correction supplies no new spatial precision.
